description: Starting a thread through _thread (kept in sys.modules, so the import guard is not involved): the audit hook refuses it on 3.12 and later. 3.11 emits no thread-start audit event, so there the seccomp filter (and RLIMIT_NPROC 0 for a non-root child) makes the start fail (RuntimeError) on Linux, root included (MSHL-323).

open_path.note: no thread-start audit event on 3.11 and no kernel guard off Linux (MSHL-289)
